title: Takiyasha's Skeleton Spectre Devours the Living
description: In Utagawa Kuniyoshi's haunting artwork, Takiyasha the Witch summons a massive skeleton to reclaim the living. The scene reveals the inevitability of death and the powerlessness of human resistance. Artwork: Utagawa Kuniyoshi (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:La_bruja_Takiyasha_y_el_espectro_del_esqueleto,_British_Museum.jpg)
